knew very well who I am and what I do.   Both were very complimentary.   Other folds 
whom I have gotten to know were there: General James Jones, Chris Wallace, Wolf 
Blitzer, Rick Atkinson, Robert Langer, Brendan Sullivan, Steve and Jean Case, etc.   
Also, there was Kellyanne Conway among others.   Surprising entertainment at the end of 
the evening was the amazing Diana Ross.   She brought the house down.   Great evening!
CNBC again on flu

Media interest continues regarding the “bad” flu season that we are
experiencing.   Today did NPR (WAMU) together with Mike Osterholm, John Barry, and 
Elizabeth Rosenthal (Kaiser now; formerly N.Y Times).
Later in the Day did WTOP radio.   Also, gave interview with Buzzfeed

Flu season expoding.   Following similar track (regarding numbers of
cases) to 2014-2015 and 2012-2013.   However, severity seems worse with stock outs of 
Tamiflu in California that is very hard-hit.   Also tents being put up in different states to 
handle cases.   Much press interest overlapping with the threat of government closure in 4 
days due to disagreement between Dems and GOP about budget, CHIP, and DACA.
I appear on CNN blog and on an interview for a future 60 minutes Australia TV shot.

Did some podcasts (Paul Vogelzang) on flu.   Also NPR NewsHour
ONLINE for topical microbicide controversy (merging [eliminating] the microbicide 
network with HPTN)
Did long filmed interview with Smithsonian on Maurice Hilleman; however, it turned 
into a feature on me to be shown on Smithsonian Website and at the Smithsonian.

News dominated by the raging flu and the threat of government closure.
Great appearance on Facebook Live for AP interviewed by Julie Pace (White House 
Correspondent and Bureau Chief for AP together with Lauren Neergaard on flu.   
However, also asked me about impact of government closure.   It was picked up by all 
print outlets and TV and went viral.
Also did Marc Siegal long radio interview for NYC – “Doctor Radio”

Tension and media interest continue on flu and shutdown.
Did VOX interview and NPR Science Friday and TV – i24 NEWS from NYC and 
TelAviv – all on flu with questions about impact of shutdown.
Government shuts down at 11:59 PM on Jan. 19
On 1st anniversary of Trump Presidency, the government shuts down.

Government still shut down (Sunday)    The hangup is that the Dems
want to put the DACA (Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals) resolution into the CR 
spending bill, but the GOP does not. They want to pass the CR and then when the gov. is 
open they will consider DACA.  The Dems do not trust the GOP since they keep kicking 
the DACA can down the road.   The Dems have offered to put “the Wall” into the bill in 
exchange for DACA.   Steve Miller of the White House (total asshole) says no and so the 
gov. stays shut.
Did FOX News this afternoon about flu.

Was scheduled to do multiple NPRs including “On Point” today
(Monday) but HHS is not allowing anyinterviewers while the gov. is closed.
Shutdown ends tonight. Resume interest in flu.   Dems cave in.   They are losing the PR 
battle.   Trump people are calling it the “Schumer Shutdown” and it is sticking.  
Government re-opens without DACA with promise by Senate Majority Leader Mitch 
McConnell that he will take up DACA before the new CR runs out on Feb. 8.   I think the 
Dems are in real trouble since the House is no going to accept a DACA deal nor is the 
POTUS even if the Senate does.   We are likely in for another shutdown.
Gave interview to Emily Bass who is writing a history of PEPFAR book

Interesting that unlike prior administrations, HHS is not giving me crap
that Flu is CDC turf, and is approving everything we send down.  Did LA Times  
interview.   
My Perspective on “PEPFAR – 15 years and Counting Lives Saved” came out today in 
the NEJM, celebrating the 15th anniversary of PEPFAR.  Yikes, time flies.

Did WTOP radio today on flu.  Still a very bad season.
        
Also did NPR – WOSU – Ohio – Ann Fisher

Flu continues to rage.  Much press interest; however, press interest is
also diverted to Trump where evidence that he colluded with the Russians in influencing 
the election or that he enacted “obstruction of justice” in trying to coerce and manipulate 
the FBI (fire Comey; threaten to fire Moeller).    Trump in Davos
Did C-SPAN Washington Journal with Gretta Brawner
Also CBS radio – all on Influenza; many blog and print also

Media still hot for flu.   Did CBS This Morning with Norah O’Donnell
and John Dickerson.
Also did NBC Nightly News
Trump gives his 1st SOTU address tonight.  It was a slight attempt at bi-partisanship, but 
then eroded into the usual.

Flu stuff hot and heavy.   Doing mostly print stuff with Wall Street
Journal and Politico

CDC came out with their weekly FluView and the numbers show that this
likely will turn out to be the most serious seasonal flu outbreak that we have had since 
tracking/recording started in 2005.   The curve is still going up and so it has surpassed 
2014-2015.
Did Al Jazeera TV and will do CNN tomorrow (Feb. 3) and Face the Nation on Sunday 
(Feb. 4)

Did CNN with Fredricka Whitfield on influenza outbreak. Good
interview, but heard tonight that Face the Nation is cancelling my segment scheduled for 
tomorrow  (Sunday) due to the commotion about the release today of the Democratic 
version of the GOP memo attacking the FBI and the DoJ

Did really enjoyable 1 hour televised blog for CBS with Major Garrett at
the Tastee Diner in Bethesda on flu + other issues such as PEPFAR.
Briefed Secertary Azar on flu down at Conference Room 610F in the Humphrey 
Building.

Did a Panel on outbreak preparedness with The Economist at the City
Club in DC
Did interview at the Newseum with Soledad O’Brien for her TV show “Matter of Fact”.
Did extended interview with CNBC on Flu here in my office.

CDC flu numbers came out.   Cases still increasing.   Clearly, this is the
worst flu season that we have had since the numbers were recorded (excluding the 2009 
pandemic)
Did WMAL radio on flu today.  Also Worcester Channel 3 TV interview by phone.

Extraordinary visit to lecture at the Ocean Reef Club in Key Largo,
FL.   Lectured at the Cultural Center on EIDs (the 5 presidents talk).   Went with Chris 
and the 2 ½ days were magical, Beautiful weather, Amazing fishing in “the flats” of the 
mangrove islands.   Unbelievable wealth of the members of the “Club”.   Memorable 
time.

Latest numbers from CDC show that the ILIs seem to have plateaued
from last week.   Let us see if the trend in now down.

Did a teleconferenced class for the Yale School of Management.   It
consisted of the Professor interviewing me with questions, followed by questions from 
the class.
Intense interest in flu still present, but somewhat slowing.

Did taping for am upcoming Good Morning America segment on
universal flu and flu challenge studies.   I was interviewed in the SCSU at the Clinical 
Center. 
Did interview with Reuters
Also, went to  to do a taped interview for the Spanish Language TV 
show Efecto Naim
Also did a podcast on influenza

Did an interview with Fox News (Bret Baier) to be aired tomorrow
   Crazy request from Francis Collins/Larry Tabak.   I have been pushing for new money 
for Universal Flu Vaccine.   We just did a strategic plan.  Francis/Larry met with 
Secretary Azar this afternoon and told him about my plan.   Alex likes it and wants us to 
put together by tomorrow morning (it is now 7:30 PM) a justification for more money 
(millions) to spend in FY 2018.   I am here with Tara trying to contact people to help put 
together this proposal.  Everyone else is gone and Francis needs it by 10:00 AM 
tomorrow.

Things starting to heat up in a good way regarding attention to and
interest in funding our Universal Influenza Vaccine (UIV) efforts.   Our strategic plan 
came out today int the JID. Several radio interviews and print stories about the plan.   
Went down to OSTP and met with J.P. Cretien and Sara Brenner to discuss our plan for 
UIV.   Also, while at the White House, ran into Tom Gossert who was very interested in 
helping us get funding.   Tom is a great guy and this is interesting since he is White 
House and this would be busting the budget.
Also, House Energy and Commerce Committee want me to come up with a plan for 
funding UIV from omnibus 2018 through several years after.   I submitted through 
Building 1 a $1 billion plan over 5 to 6 years.   E and C committee does not want HHS to 
know what we have done.   Interesting intrigue.   Word is that E and C wants to “own” 
UIV.   Everybody wants to be somebody.   Definitely seeing the fruits of my emphasizing 
UIV in medical literature, lay media, talks, etc.

Appeared on taped segment of CBS Evening News with Jon LaPook.   It
was the segment that we taped as interview + visit to the VRC discussing universal 
influenza vaccine.

Still considerable press re; H3N2 flu.   Mostly print media attention.
Today I taped a segment to appear on the Australian version of “60 Minutes”

NY Post interview.   Importantly, the flu is now dropping  considerably
as the curve shoots down.   Nonetheless, 119 pediatric deaths thus far and >80 
hospitalizations per 100,000 population.

Had my 4year review as NIAID Director.  Reviewed by Jim LeDuc,
Mark Dybul, Diane Griffin and Ray Dolin.   Went very well.  Also, Stewart Simonson 
who is now the Assistant Director-General for Management at WHO came to visit with 
some WHO colleagues to show them around NIH.   I met with them: Ambassador 
Michèle Boccoz, (ADG for External Relations), and Ranieri Guerra (ADG for Special 
Initiatives).  Had dinner at my home with Stewart 2 nights ago on Sunday, March 4.

Testified before the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on
Oversight and Investigations chaired by Gregg Harper (R-NH).   Other witnesses: Scott 
Gottlieb (FDA), Rick Bright (BARDA), Anne Schuchat (CDC).   Hearing on influenza 
response.   I spoke on the need for a Universal Influenza Vaccine.   Hearing went very 
well.   Chairman and Congressman Walden (Full Committee Chair) particularly liked my 
graphic slides.   Also, I brought in a prop – a 10 million blow-up of a nano-particle with 
HA stems attached.

(Sunday) – Part of panel hosted by NBC Doreen Gentzler at DC
Conventional Center on NIH/Science/Health.  It was an NBC4 Health & Fitness EXPO 
(25th Anniversary).   My co-panelist was Teri Manolio (NHGRI).   Good session with 
audience questions.   One man (nice fellow) got up and said his wife has a crush on me 
because I am a “rock star”.   He then went on to ask some good questions.
Am finished with my book up to end of Obama years and am now editing from beginning 
to end before I speak with and give it to Rick Atkinson.

Continued unrest and controversy in the Trump
administration regarding sex scandal with porn star Stormy Daniels and now ex-Playboy 
Bunny Karen McDougal.   Trump fires Deputy FBI Director McCabe; also fires 
Secretary of State Rex Tillerson and National Security Advisor. H.R. McMaster.   
Continued concern that he will fire independent Counsel Robert Mueller.
Flu dying down.   This has been the WORST flu season for seasonal flu in past decade 
and probably worst among “seasonal” flus on record.
Continued press interest – blogs, some TV and radio on Flu and other ID  issues.

Jim Kim (Wold Bank) visits NIH and we discuss future ways that
World Bank and NIH can work together to utilize the research discoveries of NIH to 
synergize with the implementation and “outcomes” mandate of the World Bank.   I will 
be working with Tim Evans to pursue this.
Went to the end part of a dinner at the Riggs Library at Georgetown organized by John 
Monahan to discuss “Pandemic Preparedness”.   Seems that everyone  (multiple groups – 
CEPI, NAM, Wellcome) is trying to put together a program in this area.

I am on the Lancet Commission to help towards reaching the WHO
End TB goal of 90% reduction in TB ((i.e. end TB) by 2035.   Eric Goosby is the Chair 
of this Commission.   They are in New Delhi, India now at a meeting.   I could not attend 
(too much travel and time away) but I am in close touch with Eric and am helping out 
with the final report of the commission.

Alex Azar visits NIH and in his Town Hall in Masur Auditorium calls
me out several times.  I have been talking up my support for Alex at NIH.   He receives 
very warm welcome despite the NIH antipathy towards Trump.
Garret Grigsby of HHS OGA wants to develop for Alex an HHS-Wide proposal to help 
with the End TB effort by 2035.   I have taken charge of putting together a proposal 
involving NIH, CDC, and FDA.   We have conference call today – Rebecca Martin et al 
from CDC; Marion Gruber, Ed Cox, et al from FDA; Bob Eisinger in the lead with me 
for NIH.

HHS announces that Bob Redfield will be the Director of CDC.
Much pushback from activist community who remember the scandal of 1992 when he 
overinterpreted data that he presented at the IAS meeting in Amsterdam on the 
Microgenesys gp 160 therapeutic vaccine data.   He was investigated by the DoD and 
“cleared”; however, many thought that it was a white wash investigation.  He is also 
recognized as being allied with right wing groups.   He is an Opus Dei Catholic and early 
in the Pandemic, he pushed for mandatory testing and exclusion of infected people from 
the military.
 
I have supported his past 24 years of service at University of Maryland running their 
AIDS Clinic and being Deputy to Bob Gallo at the Institute for Human Virology.  
Stewart Simonsan working with Ladd Wiley and Bill Pierce as media advisors to Alex 
and Bob have asked me to help Bob out and “show him the ropes”.

Participate at another very enjoyable “Atlantic Live” panels at The
Hamilton Restaurant (600 – 14th Street, NW) associated with showing of the film 
“Invisible Killers – Influenza” (part of a 3-part series with Influenza, Ebola and 
Smallpox).   Panel moderator was Steve Clemons (Editor-at-Large of Atlantic). I was 
prominently featured in the film.  Co-panelists were Inger Damon (CDC) and Loring 
Flint of Inova.  Great venue – food and drinks with discussion.

Gave breakfast talk/panel discussion at Brazda Health Reporters
Breakfast at APCO Worldwide headquarters at 1299 Pennsylvania Ave., NW.  Spoke on 
Pandemic influenza.
The flu cases are dramatically down and except for indication that as H3N2 is 
disapperaring, there are more cases of Influenza B.   However, apart from that, flu is off 
the radar screen.
Participated in the FDA/NIH leadership Council meeting in Building 1.   Scott Gottlieb 
there.   I spoke about Antibiotic Resistance.

Mumps outbreak in Delaware.   I did interview on WTOP.   Underlying
problem is the waning immunity to Mumps vaccine.   ACIP and CDC now recommend 
3rd shot IF there is an outbreak, not routine 3rd shot.

Gave dinner speech (5 Presidents talk) followed by 40 minutes of
questions at the Harvard Club at 555 -  13th Street, NW

Did all-day filming of me by Janet Tobias who will work for 2 years
filming me at meetings, on travel, etc for a documentary she is doing on AIDS.   Also in 
the documentary are Glenda Gray (RSA) and 2 others

Had the now usual meet and greet breakfast with Congressman Pete Sessions (R-TX) at 
the Capitol with Francis Collins and Nora Volkow.  Pete is a great guy and loves me. 
This is the 5th one that we have done.  We then rushed over to the Rayburn Building (see 
below).
Testified at the House Appropriations Subcommittee Hearing for NIH Chaired by Rep. 
Tom Cole (R-OK).   Very friendly Hearing.   Also testifying was Collins, Ned Sharpless, 
Nora Volkow, Diana Bianchi.
Went to a very crowded and extremely elegant reception at the home of George and Mari 
Will at  sponsored by the Lerner family (Owners of 
Simonson who is now Assistant DG for administration at WHO.   Signed and MOU with 
Tedros for collaborations.   NIAID will soon become a WHO collaborating center.

Did a panel on vaccines at the Metropolitan Club at 1700 – H Street,
NW chaired by Travis Brown (old friend from NCS/STA).  Sponsored by UNICEF.   
Other panel members – author Steve Johnson and UNICEF official Robin Nandy.  High-
end club.

Went to Baltimore at invitation of Bob Gallo to give the 14th Annual
Marlene and Stewart Greenebaum Lecture on “Emerging IDs” at the historic 
Westminster Church (burial place of Edgar Allen Poe).   Had lunch at Uzo Bay 
restaurant. Good to see Bob.  He is struggling with succession plan for the IHV and his 
own role in the coming years.   He is 82 years old.

Interesting evening.   Peter Staley and David Barr, my old ACT-UP
New York and TAG friends came to dinner at my house with a new young activist, James 
Krellenstein.  The purpose was to brainstorm how to get the price of Truvada down for 
use as PrEP.   They have been getting nowhere with Gilead and so they are now pursuing 
a class action suit as well as thinking about civil disobedience.  They came for my ideas 
and help.   I served the usual sausages and rigatoni with a salad of cut peppers and 
Coppola Pinot Noir and Santa Marguerita Pinot Grigio.   I offered to help by discussing 
this with Alex Azar.   Also, I read to them (with tears in my eyes) the chapter in my book 
on Jim Hill.  Jim Krellenstein is only 29 years old and I wanted him to learn some history 
of what things were like “back in the day”.

a4B7 work is not reproducd in our group with Jeff Lifson, Michele
Demascio  and Cliff Lane.   Trying to figure out why.
Trump and team continue to egregiously lie and it has become so commonplace that 
people do not even notice.

NAS Garden Party.   Met Paul Farmer and entire Farmer family pluc
Orphelia Dahl.   Learned that my candidate Dennis Kasper finally got into the NAS.   
Yeah!!

Chaired Panel at Natcher Building for the 50th Anniversary of the Fogarty
International Center.   Fogarty’s family and virtually everyone profusely thanking me for 
“saving the FIC” by my comments to the House Committee last year.   Also, the panel 
was extremely well-received – I chaired and on panel was Linda-Gail Becker, Bill Pape, 
Quaraisha Abdool Karim, and Sten Vermund.

Received the FDA Alumni Association Wiley Award at the Reagan
Building and gave Plenary Lecture at their meeting

Flew to West Palm Beach to give the Opening Plenary at the 34th Annual
Meeting of the ASM Clinical Virology Symposium and I received the Ed Nowakowski 
Award.   Spoke on Universal Influenza Vaccine.  Extremely well-received.  Beautiful 
area – West Palm Beach.

Amazing day!!   Went to Dallas on May 9 to participate in the
celebration of the 15th Anniversay of PEPFAR.   Invited by President George W. Bush.  
Took place at the George W. Bush Presidential Center.   Mark Dybul and I were billed as 
the “architects” of PEPFAR.   There were 2 panels for discussion.   Both facilitated  
beautifully by Barbara Bush (daughter).  First panel – Agnes Binaqwaho, Mark Dybul, 
Mike Gerson.  Second panel – Paul Farmer, me, Senator Lindsey Graham, Favorite 
(Favo) Iradukunda (Ph.D nursing student from Rwanda).
Excellent discussions – We all (including me) paid tribute to the POTUS who was 
somewhat embarrassed (and extremely modest) about his historic accomplishment with 
PEPFAR.
Great part of the evening where we had a private dinner in the dining room of the Center 
with Potus, Laura and Barbara Bush, the entire panel, Kenneth A. Hersh (President and 
CEO of the George W. Bush Presidential Center, as well as some young fellows from 
Barbara’s Global Health Corps.  She is stepping down after 10 years and is considering 
what her next challenge will be.
Lazarus Effect 
Engage Moderator Q
The discussions at dinner were amazing.  Great conversations,  including with Senator 
Graham describing his interactions with Trump.   He believes that Trump is a good 
person who is an “unusual character” with an attention span measured in seconds to 
minutes at the most.  George W. just listened and smiled and did not criticize, but it was 
clear that he was rolling his eyes.  Graham is a terrific person and extremely funny and 
sharp.   He is concerned about Syria and the suffering people.   He is very compassionate 
conservative who is very moderate to left on immigration.   He had just come from 
Arizonia where he visited his close friend Senator McCain who is ailing from 
glioblastoma, but is stable.   .   We 
discussed the issue of Israel likely confronting Iran and Trumps dissolving of the Iran 
nuclear deal.  Amazing night.   When we departed, I had a very warm goodbye to the 
POTUS.   Gave a long hug and I said “I love you Mr. President”.   He said: “Likewise, 
Fauci”.
    Flew back on May 10 and presented Anne Schuchat with the John P. Utz Leadership 
Award of the NFID at the NFID Gala at the Willard Hotel.    Gave a very positive 
introduction for Anne.  Met her mother who “idolizes” me.

Gave the Commencement Address to the School of Arts and Sciences at
American University.  The address was extremely well-received.   Took place in Bender 
Arena of the Butler Pavillion.   I joked with the audience saying that now that I have an 
honorary doctorate, I will not feel so guilty about using their men’s room when I run 
through the campus.   Sylvia Burwell was delighted with my accepting the invitation to 
give the address as well as the address itself.
That evening had dinner with Gepi Pantaleo at Café Milano.   Franco Nuschese made a 
special menu for us.   Just by chance that he was in the restaurant this night (Sunday – 
Mother’s Day).

Delivered AOA Lecture at Weill Cornell Medicine.   Many nostalgic
moments walking around the medical school and the building on York Avenue and East 
69th-70th Street

With Francis Collins, I helped host the visit of Barbra Streisand, her
husband James Brolin and her entourage to the NIH.  It was a great visit and she was 
wonderful to all of us.   I can now say after several encounters that she and I are friends.   
She gave the Ed Rall Cultural lecture and was interviewed by Collins on the stage of the 
Natcher Building.   I thoroughly enjoyed her and particularly her husband Jim Brolin, 
father of actor Josh Brolin.   Jim has won Golden Globe Awards for his TV performances 
as Marcus Welby, MD. He is a very modest man.  Photo below

Gave remarks in the AM to the pre-opening Press briefing of the
“Outbreak” exhibit at the National Museum of Natural History (Smithsonian).   An 
exhibit on emerging infections that we at NIAID (me, David Morens and Jeff 
Taubenberger) provided material for.  Photos of me, John Mascola and others. Great 
exhibit.   Will run for 2 years and expects 3 million visits.   Then on the road for a couple 
of years
That evening had a very elegant reception for the opening of the above exhibit.   MY 
entire front OD group attended: Cat, Hilary, Bob Eisinger, Courtney, Tara, etc.

The ebola outbreak still smoldering in DRC.   Originated in Bikoro on
Lake Tumba, but now there has been a case in Mbandaka that is a city of 1.2 million on 
the Congo River that connects with Kinshasa (DRC) and Brazzaville (Republic of the 
Congo) and so concern is that it could widely spread.   At present 44 cases and 26 deaths.
VSV vaccine being deployed for “Ring” vaccination.   We will send VRC’s mAb114 for 
protocol distribution.   All being done “differently” now in close coordination with 
WHO.   We are being very good about working with Anna Mara Restrepo of WHO; 
formerly had friction with her during the West Africa outbreak.   Much better relations 
now.
Testified before the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee of the FY 2019 budget for 
NIH.   Typical 2 hour hearing with Francis Collins, Ned Sharpless, Gary Gibbons, Nora 
Volkow, Richard Hodes and me.   I got asked about universal flu vaccine, Ebola, Zika 
vaccine and FIC.
Did long “photo shoot” with photographer (Jono Rattman)  from The Atlantic for 
upcoming story they will be doing on me.

Went to Boston to give Commencement Address at Boston University
Medical School.   Voted as choice to speak by the students.   Interesting history.   Melissa 
(Molly) Pritchard graduated today.   She used to do sleep-overs in my house with Megan 
when she was 3 years old and then she worked in the LIR for a couple of years.   Now 
she is graduating medical school.   Speech very well received.   Arrived the night before 
to have dinner at Moona Restaurant in Cambridge with Jenny and Christina.   Stopped off 
to see Lucca in Jen’s apartment.

Chris and my 33th Anniversary!!!
Taped a long segment for CBS Sunday Morning on food allergy.   To air in June.
Chris and I went to Casalare restaurant for celebratory dinner.

Went to Boston to receive Doctor of Science, honoris causa from
Boston University.   Arrived Saturday (May 19), saw Jenny, Christina and Lucca, had 
dinner at BU President’s home.   Went to Boston Pops to hear a medley of Leonard 
Bernstein works.   It was terrific.   I thought that it would be a boring concert since I did 
not know it was LB.   It was great.   Next day (Sunday, 20 May) had ceremony.  Keynote 
Speaker and also honorary doctorate was John Lewis.   He was inspirational and the 
crowd loved him.  Also receiving honorary degrees were: Zhang Yimou (Chinese film 
producer who did the opening and closing of Beijing Olympics),  Carmen Yulín Cruz 
Soto (Mayor of San Juan who conflicted with Trump during Hurricanes), and Vibha 
Bakshi (famous Indian journalist).   Beautiful day in Boston.  Good time.   It was clear 
that very few students at the college level really know who I am whereas everyone knew 
John Lewis and he deservedly stole the show.   Also, the Chinese and Chinese-American 
students (about 25% of the class) all knew Zhang Yimou.

Gave talk and panel discussion at the ASM Conference on “Outbreak” in
association with the National Museum of Natural History exhibit (see above).   I spoke on 
Influenza and a Universal Influenza Vaccine.  Other panelists – Nancy Messonier (CDC), 
Mary Wooley (Research Amer!ca).   Chair – Stefano Bertuzzi (ASM). Event at the 
Newseum.
Received a letter (May 16, 2018) from Oly Ilunga Kalenga, MOH of the DRC asking me 
to send him our mAb114 against Ebola for use during the outbreak.   The mAb was 
developed by the VRC derived from a patient from the Kikwit, DRC outbreak in 1995.   
VRC brought the patient here and cloned B cells to develop mAb.   It is very powerful 
and requires only 1 dose; is lyophilized and so does not need strict cold chain.   I wrote 
back and said we would make it available to him as long as we do this with coordination 
of the WHO in accordance with the new approach towards transparency and 
coordination.

Did teleconference presentation (me in Bethesda; they is Palo Alto) to
the Science Philanthropy Alliance to present my strategic planning process for a 
Universal Influenza Vaccine in order to get money for the project.   This organization is 
formed by Larry and Lucy (Lucinda) Page.   Larry is CEO of Google and wants to donate 
money for science, particular interest in influenza.  I could not physically go to Palo Alto 
because of Congressional hearing that will take place tomorrow.
Group (n = 40) of GOP House members wrote a letter to Trump asking him not to re-
appoint Francis Collins as NIH Director.   They claim that he promotes stem cell and 
fetal tissue research.  Also, that he campaigned for Obama.

entries.content:
Served on panel at the Wall Street Journal Health Forum at the Four
Seasons Hotel.   My panel was chaired by Betsy McKay of WSJ and co-panelist was 
Anne Schuchat (CDC).   Topic was “Gone Viral?  Tracking Epidemics”

Gave a briefing on Universal influenza vaccine to the NIH Senate
Caucus at the Russell Senate Office Building on behalf of “Act for NIH” (Pat White).   
Senators Dick Durbin and Lindsey Graham attended.   Big crowd of Senate Staffers.

Briefed Secretary Azar in his HHS conference room on tuberculosis.
This is part of the increasing momentum re: TB.   Stll unclear whether I will be attending 
the UNGASS meeting on TB in Sept.   Also, this is part of multiple briefings of Azar.

Went to Boston to celebrate the 75th birthday of Dennis Kasper with a
sumposium in his honor at the Joseph Martin Conference Center.   Then went to the 
Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum for reception/dinner.   Dennis was very moved that I 
attended and I gave the opening plenary lecture.   Jenny not in Boston.   She actually was 
in DC.   I see her tomorrow at home.

I receive the Katherine B. Gebbie Lifetime Achievement Award for
Outstanding Federal Service given to a previous winner of the Arthur Flemming Award 
that I won in 1979 (Yikes!).   Ceremony at GWU Marvin Center

I was on a panel discussing the showing of “Bending the Arc”, the
documentary of the creation and work of Partners in Health by Paul Farmer, Jim Kim, 
and Orphelia Dahl.   Took place at the NAS on 21st Street, NW and sponsored by Victor 
Dzau and the NAM.   Jim Kim and Deb Birx were on the panel with me.

Spoke at the New Hampshire Business Day event in the Hart Building at
the invitation of Senator Shaheen (D-NH). She sent me a nice thank you letter:
 
DOC334.pdf

Annual Garden Party at the home of Jamie Gorelick and Rich Waldron.
Have been going to this for years.   Usual A list there: Chris Matthews, Merrick Garland, 
etc.

Bob Redfield (new CDC Director) visited NIH and Francis Collins and I
showed him around the VRC; then I gave him a tour of the SCSU in the Clinical Center.

I testified before the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on
Oversight and Investigations on “Biopreparedness”.   Also testifying: Anne Schuchat 
(CDC), Denise Hinton (FDA), and Rick Bright of BARDA.   Very friendly Hearing.  
Congresswoman Anna Eshoo (D-CA) surprised me and the hearing room when she said 
that” “I have no questions of Dr. Fauci, but I want to say that he should be canonized”.   
She then went on with effusive praise of me and my career.  Very nice.

Was on a panel of the US Global Leadership Coalition at Grand Hyatt
Hotel in DC to celebrate the 15th Anniversary of PEPFAR.   On panel was Josh Bolten, 
Mark Dybul, Deb Birx, Congresswoman Barbara Lee and Sen. Tom Daschle.   Josh was 
clear in giving me credit for putting the program together.

Attended another typical Catherine and Wayne Reynolds dinner at the
Jefferson Hotel.   Truly the A list there.  Chatted and had fun with old acquantances: 
Colin Powel, Bret Baier (Fox News), Brendan Sullivan, Merrick Garland, Justice

Had phone call with Larry Corey about the AMP study in Africa and my
theory that those who received VRC01 and who nonetheless got infected might actually 
form the immune complexes with the VRC01 that is on board and the virus that emerges 
after infection.   I told him that we should do a study of an ATI on all these infected 
people (from the untreated versus the trerated VRC01 group) to see whether those who 
received VRC01 had developed an immune response that controls the viremia.
Also, in future vaccine studies that induce bNAbs, but the subjects nonetheless get 
infected, we should definitely do ATI studies on them and see if vaccination that did not 
protect against acquisition of infection actually induced immunity that durably controls 
virus.

Summary of important issues! The Ebola outbreak in Northeast DRC is
getting out of control in that contact tracing is being severely hindered by the rebel 
activity which is now attacking health care workers.  It is possible that it will spread out 
of DRC and into other countries in the region such as Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan. 
The latest count of cases is 266 cases and 168 deaths.   Some form of anti-Ebola 
medication has been given to 93 of these people.  Great frustration on our part (with 
Cliff) in the delay in getting an RCT going with ZMAPP as the “control” since it is the 
only countermeasure that has been shown to be safe and that has shown some efficacy 
(albeit not statistically significant) against a placebo.   Obstacles are MSF that is 
inherently against the design of the study thinking incorrectly that we are trying to show 
only that ZMAPP works, which could not be further from the truth since we believe (but 
need to prove) that mAb 114 is probably the best of the 3 drugs being uses (ZMAPP, 
Remdesivir, mAb 114) (also possibly Regeneron mAb).   Also, USAID are being 
obstructionistic claiming that we should not be doing “research” during an outbreak and 
that we should concentrate on vaccinating contacts.  In typical USAID fashion, they are 
being self-serving and in this case obstructionistic.  In contrast, Bob Redfield and CDC 
are offering to help us in any way possible to get the RCT going. 
    Also, Paul Stoffels and Janssen (J & J) are manipulating to get their Ebola vaccine into 
play (Ad26Ebola + MVA boost).   We are testing their vaccine in our PREVAC trial, 
which is a placebo controlled VSV versus Ad26Ebola in West Africa.   Paul is a good 
guy and a friend, but he is likely getting pressure from his board to get the vaccine tested 
in the outbreak.   This is somewhat of a contradiction since the vaccine is a 2 dose 
(prime/boost at day 56) that is not appropriate for an outbreak and is only suited to pre-
vaccinating HCWs and at-risk people.  Nonetheless, Paul is agitating to get the vaccine in 
play.   We will try to work it out since he is a good guy. 
MSF remains a problem.   They do not appreciate the nuances of clinical trials and they 
want to have the option if someone does not want to go into the trial in a given Ebola 
treatment Unit (ETU), then they want to option of giving compassionate use 
administration of their drug of choice.   This violates all the pricniples of an RCT.   In 
any given ETU, it is either all RCT or all comnpassionate use.   I had a conversation with 
Joanne Liu (President of MSF) at the DNDi event in NYC and although she means well, 
she insists that MSF have that option.   Also, she believes that since we are making 
ZMAPP the “control” for the reasons given above, that we are favoring ZMAPP.   It is 
tough getting through to her.   Cliff is extremely frustrated in dealing with MSF since he 
feels (and I agree) that MSF are very brave in going into dangerous areas, but they do not 
give optimal care (they refuse to give IV fluids to Ebola patients since they believe that 
patients do as well or not with oral!!!!)   This is totally nonsense.   Also, they really do 
not understand clinical research.   Since we need to deal with them, this is really a 
difficult situation.

Dr. He Jiankui (China) did a CRISPR editing of twin embryos editing
out CCR5.   The father was HIV positive, but the sperm was washed and the father was 
on ARVs with undetectable viral load.   Mother uninfected.  Therefore no chance of 
children (twins in this case) becoming infected in utero.   The purpose of the editing out 
of CCR5 was declared by the authors to be the protect the children throughout life from 
getting infected with HIV.   I consider this egregious unethical.   There was a 
groundswell of push back from the scientific community.   I was quoted in Science by 
Jon Cohen as saying: “The underlying purpose of doing the experiment was obviously to 
show that they could do gene editing on an embryo, but the purpose for the party 
involved does not make any sense,” says Anthony Fauci, an HIV/AIDS researcher who 
heads the U.S. National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases in Bethesda, 
Maryland. “There are so many ways to adequately, efficiently, and definitively protect 
yourself against HIV that the thought of editing the genes of an embryo to get to an effect 
that you could easily do in so many other ways in my mind is unethical.”

The PBS NewsHour piece over the weekend was so well received that
Murrey Jacobson (Producer at PBS) played the entire Face Book Live interview on the 
PBS NewsHour show on Monday evening.   It got widely circulated and I received 
several congratulatory e-mails about it.   The measles anti-VAXX issue is getting hot 
again with another outbreak in Washington State.

Again with measles, I did an interview by phone for CBS Digital Radio.
The SOTU address now decided for Feb. 5, 2019.   We are preparing for the rollout of the 
HHS plan to end HIV.

Went with Chris to Naples to visit JoAnne and Jim Huskey and fish off
Marco Island.   It was Chris’s belated birthday present to me.   Wonderful time.   Catch 
lots of fish – Lady fish (form of trout), see trout, catfish, snapper.  Went to an extension 
of everglades on a hydroplane and saw amazing birds and many alligators.
Preparing for the SOTU.  Should hear soon about how it will roll out re: our plan to end 
AIDS.
On Feb. 3 (Sunday) was on CBS Sunday Morning for peanut allergy (taped months 
ago).

Things are starting to come together for the announcement of the plan to
end HIV epidemic in the USA.   My editorial to JAMA was accepted in 12 hours.   I 
submitted it late at night on Feb. 4; Phil Fontanarosa editing it at mid-night and I had it 
back to them and accepted the following AM (Feb 5)
Big roll-out is planned as it looks like the POTUS will announce the initiative at the 
SOTU address on Feb. 5.  NIH roll is through the CFARs that will do the implementation 
science to inform best practices for the initiative.

Did C-SPAN this AM on anti-VAXX movement and measles
oputbreaks.   Spent almost all day preparing for the roll-out of the initiative to be 
announced at the SOTU address.   Am playing major role with Bob Redfield, Brett 
Giroir, and to a lesser extent George Sigounas and Michael Weakhee (HIS).  
Initisative is based on what I have been lecturing and talking about for some time now.   
Involves concentrating on geographic and demographic “hotspots”.   Focus on 48 
counties + DC + Puerto Rico where >50% of infections occur and 7 states with increases 
of infection in their “rural” areas.   I am not asking for new money.   Will supplement 
CFARs with $750K to $3 Million to do implementation science.
We pre-briefed 3 select reporters: Robert Pear (NY Times), Amy Goldstein (Washignton 
Post) and Ricardo Alonzo-Zaldivar  (AP) and they posted good stories right after the 
SOTU
The POTUS mentioned the initiative and so it is now on with the program.   The White 
House wants me to add at the end of the JAMA piece a statement that “We call upon 
Congress to,,,,,,”.   I do no think that Howard Bauchner will allow this, but we shall see.

Howard did not accept the White House insert and I agree with him.   Am
sending the page proofs back to JAMA without the White House change.
Today will be a day of wall-to-wall press and stakeholder briefings.
Spent all day at HHS in press briefings and outreach to stakeholders and faith-based 
organization.   Major uptake by press with explicit referrals to my role in the initiative: 
virtually all print outlets, Mike Gerson in Wash Post, Jon Cohen in Science. Excerpts 
from my press conference today run on PBS NewsHour

JAMA article out ONLINE.   Major favorable responses to roll-out.   One
recurrent issue is the skepticism of the community that as Trump administration would 
really do this.   Also, there is no budget that is publicly out and so people are skeptical as 
to whether it will actually happen.
All-in-all, very positive situation.   I have been talking about this goal of ending the HIV 
epidemic in the USA for many years and some of the press are pointing that out.  Much 
printed pres coverage.
I had an acute attack this evening of norovirus with vomiting and diarrhea.   Chris had the 
same thing starting onSaturday night in a restaurant when we went last weekend to 
Naples, FL to fish and stay with the Huskey’s.   She is still not completely better.   
Hopefully this does not last long.

Had to stay home from work today and cancel our Winter Program
Retreat due to nausea.   Did telephone link to TV with WJLA Local Channel 9 on flu in 
the virgina, DC, Maryland area.   Still widespread.

The  CROI people, who rarely invite me to the meeting to talk now want
me to give an Opening Session Plenary on the Ending HIV initiative in Seattle on Mar. 4.   
I will go.
Continued intense print press about initiative, giving much credit to Bob Redfield and 
me.

Did BBC TV on Measles outbreaks; Also did Bloomberg TV News on
the Ending HIV initiative. Did CSIS Filmed interview on HIV

Went to meeting in the Situation Room of the White House  to meet
with the NSC staff led by Charles Kupperman.   Our HHS “team” led by Dep. Sec. Eric 
Hargan; also there were Bob Kadlec, Bob Redfield.   NSC people were Jim Morrison and 
Lu Borio.   Topic was the Executive Order of the POTUS on influenza and our 
preparedness.   Eric had us put together a propose budget and plan of how HHS would fit 
into the plan in the Exec.Order.   ASPR asked for $5.3 billion.   I asked for $3.6 billion, 
mostly on universal influenza vaccine.   Let us see if we get any money from this.

Did TV interview with Katy Kay of BBC on influenza.   Also, did long
(2 hours interview with Jon LaPook of CBS for the CBS Evening News tomorrow (Feb. 
15) night and for a future “60 Minutes” segment, again on flu.
The CBS interview did not air on Feb. 15 due to the Parkland, FL shooting and killing of 
17 people.

entries.content:
Real busy (wall-to-wall) with meetings and preparations for upcoming
Hearings on Ebola, measles, House and Senate Approps, and briefings on the Plan to End 
HIV Epidemic.
Did BBC World Service Radio on our RCT for Ebola in DRC.

entries.content:
Had press briefing in “War Room” of Humphrey Building led by
Secretary Azar including remarks on new information of interim vaccine efficacy (VE) 
discussed by Anne Schuchat and comments by Jerome Adams.   Scott Gottlieb, Bob 
Kadlec and I were up on stage for questions, but there really were no questions.   The 
issue is that the overall VE was 36% for all Influenzas; however, the VE for H3N2 was 
only 25%.   Good news in that the overall VE for children 6 months to 8 years was 59% 
and for H3N2 was 51%.

entries.content:
Had dinner with Gary Nabel, Dabid Baltimore and his wife Alice Huang
at San Lorenzo Restaurant in DC.   Never been there before.   This in anticipation of 
tomorrow when Gary, David, Nancy Messonnier (CDC) and I will do a session at the 
Annual AAAS meeting on Influenza.

Press conference (much print stories) in AM and Session in afternoon at
AAAS on Influenza (see above).

Did Podcast interview with Diane Rehm on the anti-VAXX measles
situation that is still getting much attention.   I used to be a regular on her show before 
she retired.   Her show has been replaced with “A-1”, a mostly political show.   I was on 
once about 1.5 years ago, but never since.
Political situation still “hot and heavy” with everyone waiting for the Mueller report.   
Trump still egregiously lying about everything.   Congress did not vote money for his 
wall and so he has declared a “National Emergency” to use other government funds to 
build the wall without approval by Congress.   States suing and calling this 
unconstitutional.
Many Dems now throwing their hats in the ring for the Democratic nomination for 
President: Kamala Harris, Bernie Sanders, Amy Klobachar, Kirsten Gillibrand, Elizabeth 
Warren.   Still waiting on Joe Biden.

USG closed due to snow storm.   I am the “Lone Stranger” in my office
today.

Went for the day to the University of Pennsylvania Perelman School of
Medicine to be the John Morgan Visiting Professor and give Grand Rounds.   I gave my 
“5 Presidents”.   It was extremely well-received.   Was told that it was the largest crowd 
ever to attend grand rounds.  People sitting in the stairwells.   Saw a bunch of old friends: 
George Shaw, Beatrice Hahn, Alain Rook, etc.  I was “on my game” and it was a very 
enjoyable visit.
Chris having a bad month first with norovirus  
She is off to Boston this weekend to visit Jenny.

Did VOA radio interview on Ebola.   Also BBC News Facebook
interview on Measles and anti-VAXX movement.   The measles issue is getting a lot of 
play since there are reports of outbreaks throughout the world.   Many in Europe, 900 
deaths due to measles in Madagascar (due to low vaccine rates); 212 dealth in the 
Philippines.

Did Senate briefing sponsored by Sem. Ed Markey and Congreswoman
Rosa DeLauro on influenza znd universal influenza vaccine.   Ed and Rosa co-sponsoring 
an influenza vaccine bill to authorize $1billion over 5 years starting in 2020.   I gave 
opening talk in a group including Florian Krammer, Jesse Bloom, Scott Hensley, Ian 
Wilson, Gary Nabel, among others.   Chaired by David Baltimore and Simon Wain-
Hobson.
That evening went to Children’s Inn reception at the Rayburn Building.   Debbie 
Dingel and Roy Blount shouted me out during their speeches.  Chris came since she is on 
the Board of the Children’s Inn.

Testified at a Hearing of the House Energy and Commerce Oversight
and Investigations Subcommitteeon measles and anti-vaxx movement.   Testified with 
Nancy Messonnier of CDC.   Good hearing except that it was intermittently disrupterd by 
anti-Vaxx activist who kept shouting that we were liars and in bed with drug companies.   
Chairperson Diana DeGette had to warn that she would clear them from the Hearing is 
they did not stop.  Also, I was asked whether measles vaccine caused encephalitis.   I 
thought for a moment and said “no”.  The activists started screaming.   Nancy quickly 
joined in and said in a rare case, in a situation when someone is immunosuppressed, there 
can be encephalitis associated with vaccine.   I then said  “Yes, in a rare case”.   The 
activists then started tweeting that I perjured myself and lied under oath.   In fact I 
corrected myself and when I got back to the office, Greg Folkers found a paper that 
showed in a case controlled study of over 2-3 million children there was no association of 
measles vaccine and encephalitis.  Noneheless, I still got e-mails that night from activists 
(5 or 6) saying I perjured myself.   The e-mails were identical word-for-word.  Crazy 
people.

Did a filming of an upcoming (September) PBS documentary on
HIV/AIDS with a folcus on Ryan White and the new initiative to end HIV in the US.  
Some people still sending e-mails and tweeting about the measles hearing.   I have 
drafted a response to send to them saying: “Thank you for your note to Dr. Fauci 
regarding his testimony at the February 27, 2019 hearing held by the House Energy and 
Commerce Subcommittee on Oversight and Investigations regarding the resurgence of 
measles in the United States.  Dr. Fauci’s initial response when asked whether the 
measles vaccine can ever cause encephalitis was based on  a published report that failed 
to find an increased risk of encephalitis after measles vaccination in a study of more than 
2 million children (Ray et al., 
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/16940831).  However, Dr. Fauci immediately 
agreed with the clarification offered by the other witness from the Centers for Disease 
Control and Prevention, who noted that in fact there have been very rare occurrences of 
encephalitis after measles vaccination.  This very rare occurrence, in the context of 
hundreds of millions of children vaccinated, is noted on the CDC website 
(
https://www.cdc.gov/vaccinesafety/vaccines/mmr-vaccine.html) and on the package 
insert. Dr. Fauci regrets any confusion that his initial statement may have caused.  We 
will work with the Committee to clarify this point in the hearing record.”
Will have dinner with Gepi Pantaleo tonight at Fiola Mare.   He is in town on hs way to 
the CROI meeting that I will go to on Monday.

Still getting e-mails from the anti-Vaxxers regarding the briefing.   Now
they are asking questions that they clearly know the answers to in order to find some 
discrepancies.
Went on Canadian TV (CTV) to discuss measles and the anti-Vaxx movement. Did it 
by Facetime.   Off on Sunday to Seattle to present at CROI the Ending HIV Plan.

Flew to Seattle in AM. Presented Special Lecture at Opening Session of
the CROI meeting in Seattle.  4000 people in audience.   Extremely well received and 
much interest in the issue.   I flew back on red eye flight that night.   At the meeting was 
presentation (embargo broken) of 2nd BM transplant with CCR5delta 32 to HIV-infeceted 
person with Hodgkins.   Press blowing it out of proportion.   Spent most of day on Mar. 5 
after flying in on red  eye giving 2 Senate staff briefings on he plan and then doing media 
all day to discuss the transplant.   Spent most of the time downplaying it since people are 
claiming it as a major breakthrough.   
Was on NPR “Morning Edition”; WTOP; MSNBC; NBC Nightly News; multiple 
print (Reuters, Rolling Stone); BBC TV; WJLA (Channel 9 Local); Fox News TV 
(Local)

Continue to have much press about the “London” patient presented at
CROI.   Did interview today on (CBC) Canadian Radio; Sirius Radio.   I have been 
trying to keep this in proper context since the press starts off by having me comment on 
this “incredible breakthrough” with a cure around the corner. Also, ABC NewsOnline.

A lot of print and other press that I am involved in around the
“London” patient.   I have written at the invitation of The Washington Post an Op-Ed 
about the relevance of the London patient.   Currently being “cleared” through the White 
House.   Let us see what happens.
Continue to do blog and lower level media almost on daily basis: Contagion interview on 
HIV/TB; VOA TV on Ebola; World Radio Podcast on AMR, all on Mar. 8

White House approves my Washington Post editorial with virtually no
changes except 1 word.

Did Hill TV interview via skype on the London Patient.   My
Washington Post Op-Ed went ONLINE today.   Will come out later in print (never did 
come out in print).

Did an Interview on Stage with David Rubenstein for the Lasker
Lessons in leadership function.   The OXCAM students at NIH asked for me as their 
speaker and Mike Lenardo decided to have David do an interview.   Nice evening.  
Always like bright, enthusiastic  students, who (not to self-agrandize), idolize me (truly).
Did TV interview for VOA with Greta Van Susteren on HIV cure.

Busy day today.   Testified before the Senate Appropriations
Subcommittee Hearing on Ebola and other emerging ID threats – C-Span.  Then 
presented the Plan to end HIV in USA to the PACHA – Also, televised.

Went to the Indian Treaty Room of the EEOB to brief the Domestic
Policy Council (Joe Grogan and Katy Talento) and OMB people (DeAngelo and Mark  
have a juror who is the private physician to the prosecuting attorney.   Everyone smiled.   
After I left the judge told the returning jurors that the woman was taken care of by a 
“world-famous physician”.   The Washingtonian magazine reported this the next day.   I 
did not talk to the magazine because of patient confidentiality and the magazine 
mentioned this in their story.
Appeared on Turkish TV (TRT) to discuss the anti-VAXX issue.

Went to book party at the home of Jane and Calvin Cafritz  (
) to celebrate Bill Haseltine’s book World Class.   Book on the success of the 
NYU Langone Medical Center.   Ran into David Pearle who was a few years behind me 
at Cornell and NY Hospital.   He told Chris that I was a legend at Cornell even before I 
was Chief Resident 😊
The Mueller report came out yesterday with a blast.   Found Russians definitely 
interfered in our 2016 election, but there was no collusion of Trump with Russians.   
Also, although the report could not confirm a crime obstruction of justice, the report 
could “not exonerate Trump regarding obstruction of justice”.   However, as soon as the 
report came out, Trump claimed compete exoneration of both collusion and obstruction 
of justice.   Typical!

Republicans now demanding apologies/resignations of CNN,
Washington Post, Congress officials.   Much debate about AG Barr’s interpretation of 
Report.   Dems demanding to see the entire report.  Mistrust of Barr’s interpretation of 
report in his 3.5 page letter.  Something strange going on here.
Intersting side bit.   Bob Cousy received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from 
President Trump.   Trump got on the phone with Cousy to congratulate him and inform 
him of the Medal and Cousy told the POTUS: Another Holy Cross graduate received the 
Medal and he really deserved it since he has saved millions of lives.   His name is 
Anthony Fauci

Had video meeting in the SCIF with Bob Kadlec, Laura Caliguiri, Kyle
Johnson (CDC).   Here again, Bob Kadlec is talking about “believable intell”  on “bad 
actors” (China, Russia; possibly Iran and North Korea) pursuing bioterror activities with 
agents that are mutated and escape vaccine/drugs.   Also, deadly metabolic inhibitors that 
are “untraceable”.   I have heard this story multiple times over the years (since 9/11 and 
anthrax – see above), and they have never panned out under close scrutiny.   Problem is 
that now we will begin again in investing considerable resources to defend against these 
“threats”

Measles situation heating up, particularly in Rockland County, NY with
Hassidic Jewish community.   Now 153 cases.   In USA, now have 314 cases in 2019, 
more than double the entire year of 2017 (120 cases).   Did interview on BBC World 
News Radio.  Also, did interview on Fox News Radio from NYC on the officials in 
Rockland County calling an emergency, not allowing unvaccinated children (1 to 18 
years) in public places and imposing civil penalties ($500 or jail time) if they do not 
comply.
 Also did a Skype interview with the online program Now This on the ebola outbreak in 
DRC
Went tonight to a reception/buffet ggiven by the Lerner Family and George and Mari 
Will (at their home –  to celebrate the 2019 season 
of the Washington Nationals.  Clearly the Triple A social group.  Every media person 
that you can think of was there – to name a few: Chris Matthews, Chris Wallace, Jon 
Karl, Gloria Borger, Wolf Blitzer. Many pols – Ted Cruz, Chris Van Hollen.  Supreme 
Court justices – Sam Alito, Brent Kavanaugh. Ted Lerner (Owner of Nats); Edward 
Cohen (Principal owner and Vice Chairman of the Nats).   Ed was the one who invited 
me.   I helped him with a health problem some time ago.  Jeff Wilpon (son of Mets owner 
Fred Wilpon).   Nats are playing Mets on Opening Day tomorrow.

Nats lose 2 – 0.   Max Scherzer strikes out 12 and still loses.   Nats not
hitting.   
Still much buzz about measles outbreaks.   Did interview with Axios (Eileen O’Reilly).

Did interview with journalism students from University of Missouri
on HIV history.
NBC TV local (WRC) interview on adult vaccine schedule versus children vaccine 
schedule.   Recent outbreak of Mumps in Philadelphia – waning immunity.
Visit from Karen (Kingry) Olsen who brought her 29 year old gay son Dillan and his 
partner to my office to give them a history of the gay community and HIV and my role in 
the process from the 1980s.

(Sunday) – Situation has been brewing for a few weeks and coming to a
head.   Issue is the use of more widespread vaccination in DRC with the VSV 
product as well as the Janssen Ad26/MVA.  The epidemic borders between smoldering 
and going completely out of control.  Right now, there are 1069 cases and 665 deaths.   
Over 20+ health zones are involved and >50% of new cases are untraceable to a contact 
and many are identified after death.   Security issues are serious with rebel groups, 
including Mai Mai bruning ETUs.  More than 90,000 doses of VSV vaccine have ben 
administered in both a ring approach and somewhat (limited) geographic approach.  VSV 
running low and need for Ad26.   However, Ad26 requires 2 doses 56 days apart, making 
it more appropriate for geographic pre-emptive use than contact use.  The epidemic is 
really out of control.   Of late, Bob Redfied has been urging WHO to utilize the vaccine 
in a much broader public health approach.   This is being delayed by a number of factors 
including bad advice that Tedros (Director-General of WHO) is getting from his internal 
people.   Interestingly, they (who had been against research) now want to do a clinical 
trial (cluster randomization) of the VSV versus Ad26.  There is no research question here 
regarding efficacy that can be answered by such an approach.   Anna Maria Restrepo 
(WHO) and her crew are doing the usual WHO delay in getting a protocol started and this 
is delaying the deployment of the vaccines for public health versus research. Also, for 
reasons that I cannot understand, Anna Maria is telling Tedros that there are ethical issues  
in distributing the AD26/MVA vaccine.  Tedros (good guy) is concerned about safety, 
when Cliff maintains that we have ample data on safety and immunogenicity of both 
VSV and Ad26/MVA from the PREVAC study that is already fully enrolled.  PREVAC 
is a placebo-controlled trial of VSV and AD26/MVA in Guinea, Sierra Leone, Liberia 
and Mali.  Bob Redfield arranged a conference call today between me, Bob, and Jeremy 
Farrar to join forces in convincing Tedros to go with broader geographic vaccination with 
both products: VSV for contacts and Ad26/MVA for broader pre-emptive.   I called up 
Stewart Simonson in Geneva and explained situation to him and he will explain the issue 
to Tedros.   Also, he will arrange for Tedros and Bernhard Schwartlander (WHO) to call 
me today or early next week.   Other players involved are Peter Piot from London School 
and Richard Hatchett of CEPI who want to do the research trial; yet I hear that Peter is 
also with us on broader use.   The latter is the typical two-faced problem that we have 
faced with Peter (see below) and even with Jeremy.   It is a complicated situation.
A series of subsequent calls took place on this Sunday.   Stewart arranged for Bernhard 
Schwartlander to call.  Stewart called a few times and I spoke with Cliff multiple times 
(he was driving to and from soccer match for his daughter). I had a good 40 minutes 
conversation with Bernhard over the phone.   The situation is complicated.   Berhard and 
Tedros really want my involvement in this discussion because of my global credibility. 
They need to be careful in what they do and say because “they are WHO”.   They are 
concerned about saying that the epidemic is “out of control” since this creates complex 
issues for them.  They are afraid of acting too boldly and afraid of being criticized (as 
with the West Africa outbreak) of not acting quickly enough. We discussed the pros and 
cons of vaccine trials (that really will not provide efficacy data) to distribute vaccine 
versus just distributing it in a public health exercise.   Bernhard referred to the advice he 
is getting from Mike Ryan, who he considers an expert of these issues (Cliff completely 
disagrees even though he likes Mike Ryan). Bernhard is also concerned that he does not 
want WHO to look like they are playing favorites with a company, in this case Janssen.   
Remember, Paul Stoffels is pushing hard to have his vaccine (Ad26/MVA) used in any 
way (trial or deploy) in DRC. Peter Piot in my mind is playing both ends.   He believes 
that we must distribute vaccine yet he is getting money from CEPI to do the cluster 
randomization trial.   Yikes!   Very complicated situation.   More to come.

(Monday)– Busy day regarding whether or not to employ wide vaccination
in DRC versus sticking with ring/contact vaccination.   I have spoken to Bernhard, 
Jeremy (by phone on Sunday and today via teleconference from Geneva).   Jeremy is at 
Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) meeting in Geneva that I was supposed 
to attend.   However, I have 2 Congressional hearings and a House member briefing 
today and tomorrow.  
The situation is as follows.   Bob Redfield, Jeremy Farrar, Cliff Lane feel that the Ebola 
outbreak in DRC is out of control (100 cases last week).   And even though WHO is 
claiming that the VSV ring vaccine approach is working, the outbreak still progresses.   It 
has not spread into other countries and so WHO is reluctant to call it a Public Health 
Crisis of International Concern.   They are very conservative.   I spoke to Bernhard and 
Mike Ryan and will speak with Tedros tomorrow.   Bottom line – WHO people want to 
stay the course and are concerned about widespread vaccinations in geographic manner.   
They talk about “ethical” considerations that puzzle me.   Geographic vaccine would 
require using the Janssen Ad26/MVA vaccine since they have millions of doses (2 
million for now and more coming).   They would have to distribute this on a protocol 
since they do not have an emergency use authorization.   To get it, they have to declare an 
emergency, which WHO is reluctant to do. However, DRC could declare their own 
emergency.  Both sides want me to weigh in because of my “gravitas” and credibility.  I 
think that they should do widespread since they have been doing the same thing for 
months and the outbreak is still out of control.   As usual Anna Maria Restrepo is the 
obstruction.

I spoke this AM with Tedros who really wants my opinion.   I told him
that he needs to be more proactive and not get caught like Margaret Chan and be left 
behind.   He is torn since he listens to his people (Mike Ryan and Anna Maria, yet he 
knows that I, Cliff, Jeremy, Bob Redfield among others want to be more proactive with 
vaccine distribution.
Met in person with Sec. Azar in usual Ebola update meeting (I usually do by phone, but 
was downtown for Hearings).   I explained to Alex the vaccine situation in DRC.   He 
totally supports our approach of proactive vaccine.   We will both meet with President of 
DRC on Friday
Had House Appropriations Subcommittee Hearing today as well as House Energy 
and Commerce (Diana DeGette) briefing on Ebola.   Both went very well.  Also gave 
remarks at Japanese Embassy (4000 Nebraska Avenue, NW) on occasion of Cherry 
Blossum Festival celebration of 50+ years of US-Japan Bilateral Program.
Appear on FOX News TV with Laura Ingraham discussing Measles and AFM.   Went 
well.   Greg did not want me to go on program since he hates Laura.   She was great with 
me.

Discussions continue about trying to convince Tedros to listen to us rather
than his staff concerning vaccine plane for DRC.   Jeremy Farrar asked Bob Redfield and 
me where the FDA comes down on this issue. I spoke the Phil Krause and Bob spoke to 
Peter Marks.   They understand the unusual nature of the current circumstances in DRC 
and completely understand what we are suggesting regarding a wider vaccination 
effort.  As expected, they have no “official FDA position” on the issue since it does not 
involve them.  The only implications for FDA would be if J & J wanted to use data from 
the vaccine distribution for regulatory purposes.   However, that does not impact the 
public health rationale for moving ahead with a more widespread distribution of the 
vaccine.  They agree that under emergency circumstances the public health requirements 
should drive the decision making. 
Bob putting together a letter (that I edited) from Alex to Tedros explaining all this to him.  
Alex to have phone call with Tedros today.   We meet with DRC president tomorrow at 
HHS.

Did TV interview on measles outbreaks with Canadian National TV
(CTV) via Face Time (new way to do TV interviews.  Also spoke with Jeannie Baumann 
Bloomberg Law about our opioid-infectious diseases paper in JID.   Also did interview 
with Susan Scutti of CNN on the press release of starting the phase 1 trial of Barney 
Graham’s nanoparticle-stem-group 1 universal flu vaccine.

Culmination of the tension between HHS (me, Bob Redfield, Alex Azar;
also Jeremy Farrar) and WHO on whether to be more aggressive in a geographic vaccine 
program for DRC.   Azar had an “uncomfortable” conversation with Tedros this AM 
since Tedros is apparently balking at the widespread use of the J & J Ad26/MVA vaccine 
and Azar is pushing it.   Apparently my conversation with Tedros on Apr. 2 did not 
convince him, or so I imagine. The Tedros/Azar phone call took place immediately 
before we all met in Conference Room 607G at HHS with DRC President Felix 
Tshisekedi and his team of advisors. Azar pushed hard to convince Tshisekedi to 
embrace the widespread use of J & J vaccine.   Tshisekedi was non-commital, but 
indicated that he wanted to work closely with the USA and dissociate DRC from China.   
Both China and Russia have Ebola vaccines that they are pushing, but they are way 
behind the J & J product that has gone through Phase 2 in Cliff’s trial.   Azar relied 
heavily during the meeting on Bob Redfield and me to convince Tshisekedi.  WHO is 
afraid to be aggressive since they are afraid of adverse events with the vaccine used 
widely.   U.S. Ambassador to DRC Mike Hammer was at the meeting and gave me some 
insight that the Congolese really do not trust white people who come into their country 
and get excited over 1100 cases of Ebola when thousands of Congolese are dying from 
other diseases and starvation.   We do not help them with those problems; then why are 
we so concerned about Ebola.   They feel we are looking out for our own interests.

(Saturday) – The saga continues.   I spoke on the phone today with Bob
Redfield, Stewart Simonson (from Geneva) and Tedros (who was with Stewart in 
Geneva).  There seems to be some misunderstanding that I will hopefully help to 
straighten out.  After talking with Tedros this AM, he does not feel that there is any 
serious disagreement with Azar in that Tedros (as he indicated to me on previous phone 
calls – see above) is in favor of an “aggressive” vaccine approach with J & J product in 
surrounding areas in addition to continuing the ring approach with VSV in contacts.   The 
disagreement seems to be on how we are describing the situation.   Azar (and Bob) want 
to say that the outbreak is “out of control” and therefore that is why we need to expand 
vaccination.  Tedros disagrees in that he feels that in certain areas of DRC, the outbreak 
has been well controlled and it has not spread to other countries.   He agrees that in 
certain areas and in the fact that there are around 10 new infections each day, often 
without link to contacts, that it is dangerously not controlled in certain areas and there is a 
“risk” that it will get out of control.  Tedros is afraid that if we say that the epidemic in 
generally “out of control” that this is not only factually incorrect, but it would demoralize 
the 700 WHO workers who are there under dangerous circumstances trying to contain the 
outbreak.   In the end, whatever you call it or however you characterize it, the solution is 
the same, namely that we need to mount an aggressive vaccine campaign to prevent it 
from spreading further and to extinguish it.   I will contact Alex Azar and try to mediate 
this with him.
Spoke with Alex (he called me in response to my e-mail to him) and explained my

Met with Wendy (CEO) and Wayne (COO) Holman of Ridgeback
Biotherapeutics.  They now have license for mAb114.   They are concerned that we said 
in the press release and it is now going into the NEJM paper that REGN met the stop 
criteria for the study when they claim that this is not the case – it did not occur and the 
DSMB never said it did.   They want it out of the paper.   They are nice about it, but it is 
exactly opposite of what Len Schleifer  who claims we should only mention the stop 
situation and not that there was no difference between REGN nd mAb114.
     It is confusing since strictly speaking REGN did not meet the pre-determined stop 
criteria, which was a certain amount of efficacy at 28 days.   The DSMB was so 
concerned that the investigators in the field were seeing that Remdesivir was inferior to 
the others and they wanted the DSMB to look at the data and stop the study.   And so the 
DSMB used a “surrogate” of 10 days and not 28 days.   At 10 days REGN had met the 
stop criteria; however, meeting the criteria at 10 days was not the pre-determined point.   
However, when the DSMB saw all the data, they realized that BOTH REGN and 
mAb114 were significantly better than Remdesivir and ZMapp and so they said no more 
excited about Ebola and investing money when the DRC has so many other problems 
such as measles, malaria, malnutrition, violence and terrorism and no one cares about 
that.   They suspect (and they are partially correct) that the outside world (including the 
USA) cares because we are afraid that Ebola will come to us.

The experience in Butembo was transforming.   It is primitive without paved roads.   
All dirt with ruts everywhere making the motorcade go 5 miles/hour.  Tough looking

attacked the ETUs and now melt into the population.   Homes were shacks with latrine

SUVs that were highly armored and bullet-proof.   We were accompanied by several 
armored UN vehicles with UN troops and many 50 caliber machine guns showing.   The 
UN troops were mostly from Ecuador.   Also truck-loads of Congolese soldiers.  
We stopped into several units (screening; treatment; recovery, etc.) in the grounds of this 
ETU. Saw the recovering patients who had been on the PALM trial and who had 
benefitted from mAb114 and/or Regeneron.   27 day old baby – mother had Ebola, did 
cesarean section; she got Ab that passively trasnfered to child.   She died, child lived and 
is uninfected.   Amazing that we could do a trial under these conditions.
Left Butembo by same convoy route in SUVs.   Going through the dirt roads areas 
passing thousands of people was like nothing I have ever seen.   Took helicopter back to

PCC today.   No need to speak up sicne I alreadt spoke offline to Bob
Redfield and Garrett Grigsby and told them my opinion.   Garrett sent me a letter in 
which the TZ government asked for $9.9 million in USG aid for Ebola preparedness.   
Garrett asked my opinion of how to respond.   I wrote back to Garret with the following 
statement:
Garrett:
    My take on this is as follows.   In the context of not rewarding bad 
behavior, I suggest that we respond positively that we are willing to help 
with the requested financial aid ONLY on the condition that they become 
transparent about the ongoing situation in TZ regarding the woman who 
died and the supposed contacts of that woman.   The absolute condition for 
financial help is that they allow us access to samples to confirm or identify 
the diagnosis in the expired woman.   I would make our letter private at 
first, since if we make it public, then they will surely take that as a public 
accusation of their bad behavior, which I am sure will  only have them 
double down on such behavior.  I have a feeling that they are using this 
request as an implicit suggestion of a quid pro quo.  “You (USG) give us help 
($) and we will start cooperating and be transparent”.  However, if we go 
public with our response, we run the risk of embarrassing them and 
shutting down further negotiations.   Bottom line:   Respond privately with 
an offer to provide the requested resources under the conditions that I 
mentioned above.   Hope that this is helpful.
Best regards,
Tony
Garrett totally agreed with me.    More to come.
